subject.title: fix(whatsapp): add listGroupsLive for real-time group directory

question: Must WhatsApp live directory discovery always use the gateway-owned session, or may a standalone CLI process open a second credential-writing Baileys socket against the same auth directory?
rationale: The current patch makes a sensitive session-ownership choice that can affect persisted credentials and an active channel connection; repository policy favors gateway lifecycle ownership, but the permanent cross-process directory mechanism needs owner confirmation.

options.title: Use the gateway-owned session
options.body: Route the CLI request through a generic gateway/plugin directory call and prohibit another socket from opening the live auth directory.

options.title: Permit standalone sockets with safeguards
options.body: Retain the standalone path only with explicit single-owner locking, read/write lifecycle analysis, bounded timeout, and proof against a simultaneously running gateway.

options.title: Pause live standalone discovery
options.body: Keep controller-backed discovery only and defer the CLI fix until a safe cross-process directory seam exists.

recommendation.title: Use the gateway-owned session
recommendation.body: Route the CLI request through a generic gateway/plugin directory call and prohibit another socket from opening the live auth directory.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on WhatsApp socket lifecycle and credential persistence in files recently maintained in that area.
